name: otp
need: Enter a one-time code or a PIN: one cell per character, paste and autofill the whole code

--ds-otp-cell-width.description: a code field's cell: its width at size md, 8px per size step, never under the touch minimum

--ds-otp-gap.description: a code field: the gap between its cells, 2px less per density step

--ds-otp-font.description: a code field: the character in a cell (keep it at 16px or more: phones zoom into smaller field text)

labExempt.DS.otp.create: the focus moves from cell to cell at once and characters appear at once: typing shows no motion
